text: Tameeni Company was established by the Rasan group in November 2022 as a wholly-owned subsidiary, to operate Tameeni Motor and Tameeni Health and provide insurance aggregation services.
short: Tameeni is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology

source.name: Capital Market Authority (Saudi Arabia): Rasan Information Technology Company Prospectus
source.quote: Tameeni Company was established by the Group in November 2022G as a wholly-owned subsidiary for the purpose of operating Tameeni Motor and Tameeni Health
source.note: Quote is from page 152 of the 519-page prospectus PDF; the PDF parses with warnings, so the additional source carries the same ownership in plain HTML.

additionalSources.name: Rasan: Revolutionizing Insurance and Financial Services (IPO page)
additionalSources.quote: providing seamless services through our flagship subsidiaries, including Tameeni
additionalSources.note: Same page: '30% of its share capital to the public through an IPO and listing its shares on the Main Market of the Saudi Exchange in May 2024' (Rasan is the listed parent; Tadawul: 8313).
